text:
julia_support: FYI NovaApps started getting sustained 429s on their Dedicated pool right after we applied the plan change at ~12:03 UTC. Customer says traffic is steady, not a spike.

mike_oncall: What's their tenant id and the exact quota we pushed?

julia_support: tenant=nova-101. Config we rolled:```json
{
  \"rate\": 100,
  \"burst\": 500,
  \"rate_units\": \"minutes\"
}
```

raj_infra: Hmm. Our runtime expects canonical units in seconds in a few places. Legacy importer used minutes. Possible 60x mismatch.

leo_cs: Customer started seeing errors immediately after we switched their plan. They pasted a failing curl in the ticket.

julia_support: Repro (from customer):
```bash
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer xxxxx\" \
  -d '{\"input\":\"hi\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/tenant/nova-101
```
Response:```json
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{
  \"error\": \"rate_exceeded\",
  \"detail\": \"tenant nova-101 exceeded 100 requests per minute (burst 500)\",
  \"request_id\": \"req_0a1b2c3d\"
}
```

mike_oncall: Can someone pull the quota-translation logs for nova-101 and the dedicated allocator events? Look for conversions and cooldown windows.

raj_infra: Pulling logs... snippet:```
[2026-03-16T12:04:15Z] quota-import: tenant=nova-101 src=plan-service parsed_rate=100 parsed_units=minutes
[2026-03-16T12:04:15Z] quota-translate: tenant=nova-101 computed_rate=100 (no unit conversion applied)
[2026-03-16T12:04:16Z] allocator: tenant=nova-101 token_bucket max_tokens=100
[2026-03-16T12:04:20Z] throttle: tenant=nova-101 drop request_id=req_0a1b2c3d reason=rate_exceeded
```
This shows the importer wrote minutes but translate pipeline didn't multiply by 60.

ana_product: That explains the 429s even though customer traffic is modest. It's a units translation bug. We need a hotfix + temporary override.

mike_oncall: I'll open a hotfix PR to rate-convert. Quick patch: if unit==\"minutes\" or \"hours\" apply multiplier. Add a guard for unknown units.

raj_infra: Applying temporary tenant override so they don't hit 429s while we roll. Set override_rate=6000 (per sec equivalent) and note in audit.

deploy-bot: deploy started: patch/rate-convert hotfix -> canary -> prod (deploy id dpl_77f9)

raj_infra: Hotfix merged (commit f1e2d3c). Patching staging -> prod now. Also pushed migration to re-translate all recently imported plans with explicit units.

julia_support: Customer confirms errors dropped, calls are succeeding again. They saw ~5 minutes of pain. :thumbsup:

ana_product: Postmortem actions: 1) validation on plan UI to ensure units required and tooltip. 2) unit-conversion unit tests + CI gate. 3) one-off backfill script to re-translate any recent imports. 4) add alert for sudden 429s after plan change.

leo_cs: I'll send customer a note with apology + explanation + credits for the interruption.

mike_oncall: Adding follow-ups to eng backlog: (ENG-1254) unit-conversion tests, (ENG-1255) plan-import validation, (ENG-1256) quota-translation canary.

julia_support: Closing the support escalation after customer ack. Thanks all.
